EVENTS_RAW.title: MongoDB.local Mumbai
EVENTS_RAW.desc: MongoDB's one-day developer event on taking AI apps from pilot to production and modernising older systems, with technical sessions and time to meet the MongoDB team.

EVENTS_RAW.title: ServiceNow World Forum Mumbai 2026
EVENTS_RAW.venue: Jio World Centre, G Block, Bandra Kurla Complex
EVENTS_RAW.priceNote: Free · registration confirmed within about five business days
EVENTS_RAW.desc: ServiceNow's first Mumbai forum on AI transformation, with keynotes, more than 30 breakout sessions, hands-on AI labs and networking.

EVENTS_RAW.title: Lunch & Learn: AI for the festive rush
EVENTS_RAW.venue: Meta office, ONE BKC, Bandra East
EVENTS_RAW.desc: A session at Meta's Mumbai office for D2C and e-commerce teams on using AI to handle festive-season support load, WhatsApp marketing and voice agents.

EVENTS_RAW.title: EVM Capital Hackathon: Mumbai edition
EVENTS_RAW.timeNote: Saturday morning start, Sunday afternoon demos
EVENTS_RAW.priceNote: No ticket price shown · approval required
EVENTS_RAW.desc: A 24-hour hackathon for 50 to 60 builders that judges teams on real user traction rather than slides. The winning team gets an investor screening with Venture Catalysts, plus a ₹1 lakh prize pool.

EVENTS_RAW.title: Frontier D2C AI Summit, 2nd edition
EVENTS_RAW.desc: A full-day summit for consumer-brand founders and operators that mixes hands-on AI bootcamps with panels and keynotes. Registration is on D2C Insider's site.

EVENTS_RAW.title: DevDay Exchange Community: Mumbai
EVENTS_RAW.desc: A local gathering around OpenAI's DevDay announcements, to share projects, swap ideas and find collaborators. Selected attendees are offered Codex credits.

EVENTS_RAW.title: Mumbai Meets AI 06: AI × Tech Builders Meetup
EVENTS_RAW.venue: Exact venue emailed to selected attendees
EVENTS_RAW.priceNote: Free · approval required · currently full, waitlist open
EVENTS_RAW.desc: The sixth Mumbai Meets AI: a keynote, a fireside chat with practitioners, and networking. Seats count only if you register on Luma, even though it is also listed on Meetup.

EVENTS_RAW.title: The Great Shayari Showdown: human poets vs AI
EVENTS_RAW.desc: Three poets and three AI-assisted contestants each get five minutes to write shayari, and the audience votes for a winner.

EVENTS_RAW.title: IBM Think Mumbai 2026
EVENTS_RAW.desc: IBM's large one-day conference for business and technology leaders on scaling AI in enterprises, hybrid cloud and data sovereignty.

EVENTS_RAW.title: Titan Capital × V3 Ventures Consumer Mixer
EVENTS_RAW.desc: An evening for founders building consumer brands to meet portfolio founders and investors from Titan Capital and V3 Ventures, co-hosted with Kotak Mahindra. Places are limited and need approval.

EVENTS_RAW.title: Code to Capital Summit
EVENTS_RAW.venue: 70-C Nehru Road, near Mumbai airport T1
EVENTS_RAW.desc: A LegalTech gathering for founders, IP professionals, corporate leaders and lawyers.

EVENTS_RAW.title: IFP Festival Season 16
EVENTS_RAW.priceNote: Student and citizen passes; prices go up in phases from 1 Oct
EVENTS_RAW.desc: A two-day creative festival with talks, classes and showcases from about 150 artists across film, music, design, writing, photography and performance. Student passes are cheaper.

EVENTS_RAW.title: Enterprise AI Summit Mumbai 2026
EVENTS_RAW.priceNote: Free on Eventbrite; no ticket price shown on Luma
EVENTS_RAW.desc: A three-day summit on running autonomous AI systems on top of India's digital public infrastructure, aimed at enterprise leaders and technologists.

EVENTS_RAW.title: Startup Founders' Mixer: Health Tech
EVENTS_RAW.desc: A small, screened evening for founders and senior operators of consumer businesses at MVP stage or beyond, especially in health, D2C and e-commerce.

EVENTS_RAW.title: India Blockchain Week 2026
EVENTS_RAW.priceNote: Early bird general ₹1,499 · student ₹999 with hackathon eligibility
EVENTS_RAW.desc: A two-day Web3 conference for builders, founders and investors held just before Devcon in Mumbai. Student passes include workshop access and hackathon eligibility.

EVENTS_RAW.title: Media Accelerator & Startup Cohort
EVENTS_RAW.priceNote: No ticket price shown · approval required
EVENTS_RAW.desc: A Devcon-week side event that connects blockchain and AI startups with investors and media, with mentoring and a pool of funding and grants for selected teams.

EVENTS_RAW.title: Devcon 8 India
EVENTS_RAW.priceNote: Indian students $25 by application · India residents $149 · general $499
EVENTS_RAW.desc: The Ethereum Foundation's global developer conference, held in Mumbai this year across four days. It is open to engineers, designers, researchers, educators and artists, not only developers.

EVENTS_RAW.title: AICD Mumbai
EVENTS_RAW.venue: Microsoft India office, Central Salsette Tramway Road
EVENTS_RAW.desc: A free full-day community conference on Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Azure and AI, with keynotes and workshops.

EVENTS_RAW.title: Hackathon @ Mobile Architecture Lab 4
EVENTS_RAW.priceNote: No ticket price shown · registration open
EVENTS_RAW.desc: A one-day hackathon where solo builders or teams of two to three create a mobile app around a challenge announced on the day.

EVENTS_RAW.title: StartupLive Mumbai'26
EVENTS_RAW.priceNote: Ticket price not shown · some tickets need approval
EVENTS_RAW.desc: A two-day startup event at IIT Bombay with a 90-second pitch round, workshops and mentoring on day one, and final pitches before investors on day two.

EVENTS_RAW.title: Hackverse 19
EVENTS_RAW.venue: Smt. Indira Gandhi College of Engineering
EVENTS_RAW.desc: A space-technology hackathon with an online slide round followed by a 24-hour coding round at the college, with a prize pool of ₹35,000.
